_comment: Lineup (Nathan 2026-11-15 03:00): no Anthropic API anywhere. roles: autoresearch backend:model specs (llm.get_llm); petri: Inspect model ids for harness/petri/run_audits.py (openai-api/modal/<m> = the target's OpenAI-compatible server, openai-api/modalaud/<m> = the auditor's). Several openai-compat servers in one run: OPENAI_COMPAT_ENDPOINTS (llm.py). Main target: Nathan picked Kimi K2.5 on Tinker; Abhi does not want Tinker runs, so the runnable dev target stays Qwen3-30B-A3B on Modal until they agree (Kimi listed as held-out). Check: python3 -m autoresearch.research.models_config

dev_target.env: OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL (and MODAL_BASE_URL for Inspect), OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY = MODAL_API_KEY = the vllm-key secret
dev_target.cost_note: billed per GPU-second, not per token: one H100 at Modal list price (about $3.95/h at the time of writing; check modal.com/pricing). Scales to zero after 15 idle minutes.

waivers.reason: generator openai:gpt-6-luna and both held-out judges (gpt-5.1, gpt-oss-120b) are OpenAI-family; accepted trade-off for budget (no Anthropic, open models on Modal). A third-family judge (e.g. openai-compat:deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, probe set already in evaldetect_probes.json) would remove this waiver

judge_choice: gpt-5.1 over gpt-5 as the OpenAI judge: its EvalDetectBench probe set is already in data/benchmarks/evaldetect_probes.json (AUROC 0.802 on our export); gpt-5 and gpt-oss-120b have none
